title: Past-Due Amount on a Home Delivery Pharmacy Account
content:
## Billing terms clause: the past-due amount

**Clause.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy account, the past-due settlement is the member charges and expedited fees of the settlement period that are at least one whole month old on the handling date, less the credits and the payments other than plan installments posted in the settlement period (payments other than installments posted on the plan's request date, which are the plan's down payment, are not counted), never below zero and rounded to the nearest cent.

The settlement period is counted in whole months from the member's current payment plan: it covers entries dated less than N whole months before the handling date, N being one more than the number of whole months from the plan's request date to the handling date; entries dated earlier than that belong to the balance the plan financed and are never part of the settlement.

### Terms of the clause

1. **Current payment plan.** The account's most recent payment-plan request recorded as completed; its request date anchors the period.
2. **Charges counted.** Member charges on shipment records and expedited shipping-fee charges, dated in the settlement period and at least one whole month old on the handling date.
3. **Taken off.** Every credit posted in the period, and every payment in the period that is not a plan installment, except such payments posted on the plan's request date.
4. **Floor and rounding.** The result is never below zero and is rounded to the nearest cent.

### Worked figure (hypothetical account, handling date 20 June)

The current plan was requested on 10 March, 3 whole months before the handling date, so N is 4 and the period covers entries dated less than 4 whole months before 20 June.

| Entry in the period | Amount | Counted |
|---|---|---|
| Member charge, shipment of 2 April | 45.00 | yes, at least one whole month old |
| Member charge, shipment of 5 May | 30.00 | yes |
| Expedited fee, 5 May | 14.95 | yes |
| Member charge, shipment of 10 June | 25.00 | no, less than one whole month old |
| Credit, 12 May | 14.95 | taken off |
| Payment by card, 2 June, not an installment | 20.00 | taken off |
| Payment, 10 March (plan's request date), not an installment | 30.00 | not counted, it is the down payment |
| Installment payment, 10 April | 80.00 | not counted, it is a plan installment |

Past-due amount: 45.00 plus 30.00 plus 14.95 is 89.95; less 14.95 and 20.00 leaves 55.00.
